hartmann/abwandlung.hinweis: modification: recurring luminous forms reshaped and re-tuned as they rise into a higher stratum, the same motif transformed to fit a nobler order
hartmann/abwandlung.name: Die Abwandlung

hartmann/anorganische_schicht.hinweis: the inorganic stratum: the physical-material ground of all being, the widest and strongest lowest layer, a vast dense field of matter, energy and law
hartmann/anorganische_schicht.name: Die anorganische Schicht

hartmann/artprozess.hinweis: the process of the species: reproduction and preservation of the kind beyond the single individual, a luminous lineage flowing across generations
hartmann/artprozess.name: Der Artprozess

hartmann/bewusstsein.hinweis: consciousness, the becoming-aware: a luminous inner space bearing perception, feeling and striving, an interior light turned toward the world
hartmann/bewusstsein.name: Das Bewusstsein

hartmann/dynamischer_prozess.hinweis: the dynamic process: the flowing interplay of natural forces and events, a field of streaming energies and shifting equilibria
hartmann/dynamischer_prozess.name: Der dynamische Prozess

hartmann/erkenntnis.hinweis: knowledge as a transcendent act: a beam of light reaching across a gap to grasp a being that exists in itself, apprehending and not creating its object, critical realism
hartmann/erkenntnis.name: Die Erkenntnis

hartmann/erleben.hinweis: lived experience: the flowing stream of the conscious in which world and self are given, a luminous inner current
hartmann/erleben.name: Das Erleben

hartmann/freiheit_des_oberen.hinweis: the freedom of the higher: the upper stratum dependent yet autonomous, a bright open play-space of the undetermined hovering above the fixed lower order, where freedom becomes possible
hartmann/freiheit_des_oberen.name: Die Freiheit des Oberen

hartmann/geistige_schicht.hinweis: the spiritual stratum: the highest layer, most autonomous yet most dependent, bearer of knowledge, values and history, a radiant summit resting on all below
hartmann/geistige_schicht.name: Die geistige Schicht

hartmann/ideales_sein.hinweis: ideal being beside the real: a timeless luminous realm of mathematicals, logical laws, essences and values that subsist without existing, a serene crystalline order apart from the real strata
hartmann/ideales_sein.name: Das ideale Sein

hartmann/kausalitaet.hinweis: causality: a continuous chain of luminous links, the basic form of natural determination, modified as it ascends into higher strata
hartmann/kausalitaet.name: Die Kausalität

hartmann/leben.hinweis: life, the new ground category: a whole self-maintaining organic organization, a luminous form that sustains itself through the flux of matter
hartmann/leben.name: Das Leben

hartmann/logische_gesetze.hinweis: the logical laws: the laws of non-contradiction and consequence as luminous invariant structures, valid for both real and ideal being
hartmann/logische_gesetze.name: Die logischen Gesetze

hartmann/materie.hinweis: matter, the substrate that bears and recurs in every real stratum: a primordial glowing substance, the enduring stuff underlying all levels
hartmann/materie.name: Die Materie

hartmann/math_gegenstaende.hinweis: mathematical objects: ideal numbers and proportions as luminous geometric archetypes, recurring within everything real yet themselves timeless
hartmann/math_gegenstaende.name: Die mathematischen Gegenstände

hartmann/novum.hinweis: the categorial novum: at each higher stratum genuinely new lights blaze forth that cannot be derived from below, unprecedented forms appearing at a threshold
hartmann/novum.name: Das kategoriale Novum

hartmann/objektiver_geist.hinweis: the objective spirit: the shared supra-personal spirit, language law custom science and art, a living luminous web binding many minds across history
hartmann/objektiver_geist.name: Der objektive Geist

hartmann/objektivierter_geist.hinweis: the objectified spirit: spirit fixed in works, books buildings and artworks, dormant crystallized lights that reawaken only when re-enacted by a living mind
hartmann/objektivierter_geist.name: Der objektivierte Geist

hartmann/organische_determination.hinweis: organic determination: the living own form of causation without external purpose, an inner self-shaping order, life ordering itself without a goal imposed from outside
hartmann/organische_determination.name: Die organische Determination

hartmann/organische_schicht.hinweis: the organic stratum: the living, over-formed upon matter with its own determination, a novum of glowing life resting wholly on the inorganic
hartmann/organische_schicht.name: Die organische Schicht

hartmann/personaler_geist.hinweis: the personal spirit: spirit as person, a single luminous focus of I, will and moral responsibility, a bright self-aware centre
hartmann/personaler_geist.name: Der personale Geist

hartmann/raum.hinweis: space, the ground category of the material: an infinite crystalline three-dimensional lattice, a dimension that does not recur in the psychic heights
hartmann/raum.name: Der Raum

hartmann/schichtungsgesetz.hinweis: a vast vertical edifice of four luminous strata stacked one upon another, each higher layer resting on the deeper yet governed by its own categories, the architecture of the real world
hartmann/schichtungsgesetz.name: Das Schichtungsgesetz

hartmann/seelische_schicht.hinweis: the psychic stratum: consciousness merely built above the organic, a spaceless novum with its own intentionality, an inner non-spatial glow above the living body
hartmann/seelische_schicht.name: Die seelische Schicht

hartmann/seelischer_akt.hinweis: the intentional act: a beam of inner light directed at an object, consciousness reaching out and aiming beyond itself
hartmann/seelischer_akt.name: Der seelische Akt

hartmann/selbstregulation.hinweis: self-regulation: an organism looping back upon itself, glowing feedback circuits preserving form amid the exchange of substance
hartmann/selbstregulation.name: Die Selbstregulation

hartmann/sittliche_freiheit.hinweis: moral freedom: determination by values within the open play-space of natural causality, a higher luminous order steering through the gaps of the lower, freedom above nature not against it
hartmann/sittliche_freiheit.name: Die sittliche Freiheit

hartmann/staerke_des_unteren.hinweis: the strength of the lower: the deepest stratum is the strongest, a massive luminous foundation bearing all above it, carrying the higher yet not fully determining it
hartmann/staerke_des_unteren.name: Die Stärke des Unteren

hartmann/trieb_gefuehl.hinweis: drive and feeling: the dark urging under-layer of the psyche, a churning warm dimness beneath the light of consciousness
hartmann/trieb_gefuehl.name: Trieb und Gefühl

hartmann/ueberbauung.hinweis: over-building: soul and spirit merely built above the lower and not remoulded from it, higher luminous storeys standing free and detached upon a solid base, greater distance
hartmann/ueberbauung.name: Die Überbauung

hartmann/ueberformung.hinweis: over-forming: the material stratum itself taken up and reshaped into living form, dense matter moulded and kneaded into a glowing living structure
hartmann/ueberformung.name: Die Überformung

hartmann/werte.hinweis: the values: ideal determinacies that make an ethical claim, a high firmament of shining value-forms becoming real only in the spirit, a starry realm of oughts
hartmann/werte.name: Die Werte

hartmann/wesenheiten.hinweis: the essences: the universal what-nesses, radiant archetypal patterns recurring within all real things, the whatness shining through the particulars
hartmann/wesenheiten.name: Die Wesenheiten

hartmann/wiederkehr.hinweis: the recurrence of categories: threads of light rising from the lower strata and reappearing in the higher ones, but never all of them and never unchanged, a partial ascent of luminous motifs
hartmann/wiederkehr.name: Die Wiederkehr der Kategorien

hartmann/zeit.hinweis: time, the one category running through every stratum: a single luminous line flowing unbroken from natural process up to historical spirit
hartmann/zeit.name: Die Zeit

hegel/absolute_idee.hinweis: a radiant ouroboros encircling a small ordered cosmos of thought, the complete self-knowing whole
hegel/absolute_idee.name: Die absolute Idee

hegel/buergerliche_gesellschaft.hinweis: a teeming luminous web of labour and exchange, interdependent figures, the system of needs
hegel/buergerliche_gesellschaft.name: Die bürgerliche Gesellschaft

hegel/das_aufheben.hinweis: an ascending spiral in which a shape dissolves yet is preserved and lifted higher, three moments in one upward motion
hegel/das_aufheben.name: Das Aufheben

hegel/das_dasein.hinweis: a single luminous bounded form crystallizing out of formless light, the first determinate thing standing forth
hegel/das_dasein.name: Das Dasein

hegel/das_nichts.hinweis: an utterly empty void of deep darkness, absolute absence, the vanishing of all form
hegel/das_nichts.name: Das reine Nichts

hegel/das_sein.hinweis: a boundless radiant field of pure pale light, the barest luminous presence before any form
hegel/das_sein.name: Das reine Sein

hegel/das_werden.hinweis: an elegant bottle of red wine whose label bears the portrait of a stern nineteenth-century philosopher, a full glass glowing beside it in warm candlelight, grapes fermenting into wine as an image of becoming, witty yet refined, a toast to dialectics
hegel/das_werden.name: Das Werden

hegel/das_wesen.hinweis: a veiled ground mirrored in dark still water, a hidden essence shining through mere appearance
hegel/das_wesen.name: Das Wesen

hegel/der_begriff.hinweis: a self-enclosing luminous ring holding a living organic seed at its centre, self-determining unity
hegel/der_begriff.name: Der Begriff

hegel/der_staat.hinweis: a majestic ordered city rendered as a single crowned civic body, many citizens forming one dignified organism
hegel/der_staat.name: Der Staat

hegel/der_weltgeist.hinweis: a colossal luminous figure striding through the monuments of successive historical epochs
hegel/der_weltgeist.name: Der Weltgeist

hegel/die_kunst.hinweis: the absolute shining through a glowing classical sculpture, divine radiance breaking from sensuous art
hegel/die_kunst.name: Die Kunst

hegel/die_natur.hinweis: the idea externalized as a vast living landscape unfolding out of crystalline geometry
hegel/die_natur.name: Die Natur

hegel/die_philosophie.hinweis: the owl of Minerva taking flight at dusk above a twilit landscape of thought
hegel/die_philosophie.name: Die Philosophie

hegel/die_religion.hinweis: a congregation beholding a luminous sacred vision, the absolute in devotional representation
hegel/die_religion.name: Die Religion

hegel/herr_und_knecht.hinweis: two figures locked in a struggle for recognition, one dominant one labouring, mirrored and bound
hegel/herr_und_knecht.name: Herrschaft & Knechtschaft

hegel/objektiver_geist.hinweis: an ordered architecture of law and ethical life, human figures bound by an invisible geometric order
hegel/objektiver_geist.name: Der objektive Geist

hegel/subjektiver_geist.hinweis: a solitary human figure awakening to self-awareness, an inner light kindling within, the mind turning inward
hegel/subjektiver_geist.name: Der subjektive Geist

kant/antinomien.hinweis: the antinomies: reason at war with itself, two luminous arguments of equal force locked in mirror-opposition, and through the third a door of freedom opening
kant/antinomien.name: Die Antinomien

kant/apperzeption.hinweis: the I-think, the original synthetic unity of self-consciousness: a single radiant point to which all threads of thought are gathered, the highest binding point
kant/apperzeption.name: Die Apperzeption — „Ich denke“

kant/das_erhabene.hinweis: the sublime: an overwhelming vastness, a towering storm-mountain over a star-filled abyss, exceeding every sensible measure and awakening the vocation of reason
kant/das_erhabene.name: Das Erhabene

kant/das_schoene.hinweis: the beautiful, disinterested delight: a harmonious luminous form pleasing universally without a concept, the serene free play of imagination and understanding
kant/das_schoene.name: Das Schöne

kant/der_mensch.hinweis: the human being, the question uniting all: a distant luminous figure standing between the starry cosmos above and the moral law within, what is the human
kant/der_mensch.name: Der Mensch

kant/die_seele.hinweis: the soul as the psychological idea: a solitary radiant point mistaken for a simple substance, an elusive wandering marsh-light of the thinking self
kant/die_seele.name: Die Seele

spinoza/unendliche_attribute.hinweis: the unknown infinite attributes: countless radiant dimensions fanning out beyond the two we know, an infinity of hidden facets of the one substance
spinoza/unendliche_attribute.name: Die unbekannten Attribute

thomas/amor_spiritus.hinweis: Love, the Spirit breathed forth by way of will from the Father and the Word: a warm living flame flowing between two radiances, a bond of fire
thomas/amor_spiritus.name: Die Liebe (Spiritus)

thomas/analogia_entis.hinweis: the analogy of being: a graded ladder of light rising from creatures to God by proportion and order, likeness held within an ever greater unlikeness, no single line
thomas/analogia_entis.name: Die Analogia entis

thomas/das_esse.hinweis: the act of being, the actuality of all actualities: a pure spark of existence gifting reality to everything, a bestowed radiance in which all things share
thomas/das_esse.name: Das Esse — der Seinsakt

thomas/die_essentia.hinweis: essence as receptive limit: a crystalline vessel that receives and bounds the act of being as potency bounds act, a shaped chalice of light
thomas/die_essentia.name: Die Essentia — das Wesen

thomas/engel.hinweis: the angels, separate substances, pure forms without matter, each its own species: a hierarchy of distinct bodiless luminous intelligences in ordered ranks
thomas/engel.name: Die Engel (substantiae separatae)

thomas/gott_ipsum_esse.hinweis: subsisting being itself, pure act: an infinite pure radiance in which essence and existence are one, the boundless self-existing fount of all being
thomas/gott_ipsum_esse.name: Gott — ipsum esse subsistens

thomas/gratia.hinweis: grace, which does not abolish nature but perfects it: a descending radiance crowning and completing a natural form, light raising nature to its fulfillment
thomas/gratia.name: Die Gratia

thomas/lex_naturalis.hinweis: the natural law, the share of the rational creature in the eternal law: luminous inscribed lines of order shining within the mind, a reflection of eternal law
thomas/lex_naturalis.name: Die Lex naturalis

thomas/malum.hinweis: evil as privation of due good, not a being: a wound of darkness where light should be, an absence gnawing at the edge of a radiant order, a hole in being
thomas/malum.name: Das Malum

thomas/mensch_horizon.hinweis: the human being as horizon and boundary: a soul poised on the frontier between the dense material world below and the world of pure spirits above, half in earth half in light
thomas/mensch_horizon.name: Der Mensch — horizon et confinium

thomas/prima_materia.hinweis: prime matter, pure potency, itself created and unable to exist without form: a formless dim substrate at the edge of darkness awaiting the touch of form and light
thomas/prima_materia.name: Die prima materia

thomas/synderesis.hinweis: synderesis, the inextinguishable habit of the first practical principles: a small unquenchable ember of moral light glowing deep within, never fully darkened
thomas/synderesis.name: Die Synderesis

thomas/transzendentalien.hinweis: the transcendentals unum verum bonum, convertible with being: three interwoven radiances forming one luminous unity, the same light seen as one true and good
thomas/transzendentalien.name: Die Transzendentalien

thomas/verbum.hinweis: the Word, begotten not made: a luminous logos of perfect light proceeding from the source by way of knowing, a radiant utterance of the divine mind
thomas/verbum.name: Das Wort (Verbum)

thomas/virtutes.hinweis: the infused theological virtues, faith hope and love above the cardinal virtues: three luminous flames set above four steadfast pillars, gifts of grace
thomas/virtutes.name: Die eingegossenen Tugenden

thomas/visio_beatifica.hinweis: the beatific vision, the sight of the divine essence: a soul flooded and dissolved in the direct radiance of God, perfect blessedness in unmediated light
thomas/visio_beatifica.name: Die Visio beatifica

zoroastrismus/aeshma.hinweis: Asmodäus (mit Aeshma gleichgesetzt), Illustration aus dem „Dictionnaire Infernal" — Figurenausschnitt
zoroastrismus/aeshma.name: Aeshma
